changelog:
Bilibili All-in-One skill v1.0.12

- Integrates hot trending monitoring, video downloading, playback, subtitle downloading, and video publishing for Bilibili in one unified tool.
- Supports both command-line and API interfaces; works in Chinese and English.
- Allows authenticated publishing and high-quality downloads using Bilibili session cookies.
- Offers hot list monitoring, batch/multi-format downloads, danmaku and stats viewing, subtitle handling, and YouTube video stats via oEmbed.
- Includes detailed setup, security, and credential usage instructions for safe operation.
summary: A comprehensive Bilibili toolkit that integrates hot trending monitoring, video downloading, video watching/playback, subtitle downloading, and video publish...
